candidates.name: X-linked hypophosphatemia
support_spans: elevated alkaline phosphatase level of 220 U/L
phosphorus level of 2.1 mg/dL
fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF23) 1241 RU/mL (<180)
contradict_spans: genetic evaluation for hypophosphatemic disorders, including X-linked hypophosphatemia, was unremarkable
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of hypophosphatemia, elevated alkaline phosphatase, and high FGF23 levels are consistent with X-linked hypophosphatemia, despite unremarkable genetic evaluation.

candidates.name: Osteomalacia
support_spans: elevated alkaline phosphatase level of 220 U/L
phosphorus level of 2.1 mg/dL
25-OH vitamin D 14.8 ng/mL (30–95)
candidates.why: The patient's low vitamin D level, hypophosphatemia, and elevated alkaline phosphatase are consistent with osteomalacia.

candidates.name: Fibrous dysplasia
support_spans: a 9×8-mm intracortical lesion in the anterolateral right fibular head
gallium-68 DOTATATE PET/MRI showed uptake in a right femoral neck stress fracture and bilateral calcaneal stress fractures
candidates.why: The patient's imaging findings, including the intracortical lesion and multiple stress fractures, are consistent with fibrous dysplasia.

candidates.name: Osteomalacia
support_spans: elevated alkaline phosphatase level of 220 U/L
phosphorus level of 2.1 mg/dL
25-OH vitamin D 14.8 ng/mL
candidates.why: The patient's laboratory results, including elevated alkaline phosphatase and low phosphorus and vitamin D levels, are consistent with osteomalacia.

candidates.name: Osteomalacia
support_spans: elevated alkaline phosphatase level of 220 U/L
phosphorus level of 2.1 mg/dL
bone densitometry showed Z-scores of −2.5 in the lumbar spine and −1.9 in the femoral neck
candidates.why: The patient's laboratory results and bone densitometry are consistent with osteomalacia, a condition characterized by softening of the bones due to impaired bone mineralization.

candidates.name: Fibrous Dysplasia
support_spans: a 9×8-mm intracortical lesion in the anterolateral right fibular head
gallium-68 DOTATATE PET/MRI showed additional uptake in a right femoral neck stress fracture and bilateral calcaneal stress fractures
candidates.why: The presence of an intracortical lesion and multiple stress fractures, as well as the patient's history of disabling bilateral hip, knee, and ankle pain, are suggestive of fibrous dysplasia, a condition in which normal bone is replaced by fibrous tissue.

candidates.name: Hypophosphatemic Rickets
support_spans: elevated FGF23 level of 1241 RU/mL
low phosphorus levels despite phosphate supplementation
contradict_spans: genetic evaluation for hypophosphatemic disorders, including X-linked hypophosphatemia, was unremarkable
candidates.why: The patient's elevated FGF23 level and persistent hypophosphatemia despite supplementation are consistent with hypophosphatemic rickets, although the negative genetic evaluation for X-linked hypophosphatemia suggests that another form of the disorder may be present.

selector.rationale: Elevated alkaline phosphatase level and low phosphorus level with low 25-OH vitamin D level, which are characteristic of osteomalacia

rejected.label: Hypophosphatemic Rickets
rejected.why: Genetic evaluation was unremarkable and low phosphorus levels can be explained by osteomalacia
